subject: Defend vs. Reimburse sequencing and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Elaine Sellers <elaine.sellers@ardentbio.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@ardentbio.com, tom.harrigan@ardentbio.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up on indemnity sequencing and evidence window

Rishi,

Thanks for the draft MSA — legal here had a few questions on the indemnity sequencing that will impact our procurement timeline. In particular:

- We need clarity on whether ArdentBio will be able to require Redwood to step in and defend third-party IP claims (right to defend) or whether ArdentBio will defend and seek reimbursement.
- If Redwood seeks to defend, we need visibility into the counsel selection process and an SLA for notice and transfer of evidence (we typically require 10 business days to review technical evidence).
- Evidence preservation: can Redwood commit to a 3-year preservation window for logs/evidence and a named custodian?

We appreciate the willingness to compromise — would Redwood accept a hybrid approach where Redwood has the right to defend for product-related claims and ArdentBio retains reimbursement for customer data-output claims? If so, please send a tracked-change redline and an evidence checklist so we can route internally.

Would like to keep procurement live this month; can you confirm?

Best,
Elaine Sellers
Head of Legal Operations
ArdentBio

Attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Sellers <elaine.sellers@ardentbio.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up on indemnity sequencing and evidence window

Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and next steps below.

Short answers:
- We can accept a hybrid defend/reimburse model, but need a narrow definition of "product-related claim" (we propose: claims arising from Redwood-supplied code, models, or infringing model weights).
- Counsel selection: Redwood proposes mutual approval (one counsel each) with the right for either party to object for conflict; Redwood would require primary control only if we elect to defend.
- Notice & evidence timing: we can commit to a 72-hour initial acknowledgement on receipt of a notice, and propose a 14-calendar-day evidence staging window for handover; we can be flexible if Ardent needs a longer review.
- Evidence preservation: 3 years is acceptable; we will name our security ops lead as custodian and produce a checklist of the artifacts we can provide.

Attachments: I am sharing a tracked-change redline and an evidence-triage checklist for your team to review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Review the attached redline (Redwood_Proposed_Redlines.docx) and confirm whether the proposed "product-related claim" language is acceptable (suggested definition in §4.2).
2) If OK, we iterate on counsel selection language and sign off on an evidence SLA; otherwise we schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call.
3) Procurement to confirm timeline; if Ardent needs more time for internal sign-off, please propose dates.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Jordan to track legal/ops implications.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_Redlines.docx, Evidence_Triage_Checklist.xlsx
From: Elaine Sellers <elaine.sellers@ardentbio.com>

Cc: legal@ardentbio.com, tom.harrigan@ardentbio.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up on indemnity sequencing and evidence window

Rishi — appreciate the fast reply and attachments. A couple of clarifying questions after an initial read:

- Your 14-day staging window is reasonable for handover, but procurement/legal needs explicit language around escrow or preservation hold once notice is received (to avoid evidence deletion). Can Redwood include a preservation-trigger clause tied to the notice?
- On counsel selection: mutual approval is workable, but we typically ask for default selection if one party fails to respond in 5 business days. Can Redwood accept that as a fallback?
- Insurance certificate: procurement needs confirmation of limits and carrier (we can accept the certificate stub for now).

We are tentatively comfortable with the proposed product-related claim definition but want to kick off a short joint call to lock counsel-selection fallback and the preservation-trigger language. Can your team do Friday, Nov 20 at 9:30am PT?

Thanks,
Elaine

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:01:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up on indemnity sequencing and evidence window

Elaine — quick operational notes from our side ahead of the call:

- Preservation-trigger: Redwood can accept a clause that places affected logs/evidence on litigation hold upon receipt of a notice, subject to reasonable scoping (we cannot hold unrelated production data longer than necessary). Proposed language attached in the redline.
- Fallback counsel selection: 5 business days default is acceptable to Redwood as a fallback; Redwood suggests documenting the default counsel details in the order form to speed execution.
- Evidence custodian: assigning our Security Ops lead (M. Ortiz, security.ops@redwood.ai) is fine; certificate of insurance attached for procurement.

I look forward to the joint call at 9:30am PT.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on indemnity sequencing and evidence window — post-call notes

Elaine / team — thanks for the call this morning. Summary / action items: 

1) Agreement in principle on hybrid defend/reimburse split — Redwood will defend product-related claims; ArdentBio will handle customer output claims. Rishi to push final definition into §4.2 and circulate. (owner: rishi_malhotra)
2) Preservation-trigger clause accepted with narrow scope; Kimberly to add redline language and final example artifacts list. (owner: kimberly_park)
3) Counsel fallback: 5 business day default will be added; both parties to supply default-counsel contact details in the order form. (owner: jordan_blake)
4) Evidence handover timing: initial acknowledgement within 72 hours; staging window 14 days but can be extended by mutual agreement for complex matters.
5) Procurement: Ardent to confirm signature timeline; Redwood to upload final redline and insurance certificate to the HubSpot deal record.

Deliverables by EOD Monday Nov 23: final tracked redline (Rishi), finalized evidence checklist (Kimberly), and default counsel contacts (Jordan).

If I've missed anything, please flag. Otherwise we'll circulate the updated redline and tag the deal to move to signature.

Thanks,
Rishi
